ATAN.summary: The arctangent of a number, in radians.

ATAN2.summary: The arctangent of x and y coordinates, in radians.

ATANH.summary: The inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number.

BASE.summary: Converts a number to text in another base (radix).

CEILING.PRECISE.summary: Rounds a number up to the nearest multiple, whatever its sign.

COS.summary: The cosine of an angle in radians.

COSH.summary: The hyperbolic cosine of a number.

COT.summary: The cotangent of an angle in radians.

COTH.summary: The hyperbolic cotangent of a number.

CSC.summary: The cosecant of an angle in radians.

CSCH.summary: The hyperbolic cosecant of a number.

DECIMAL.summary: Converts text in a given base to a number.

FLOOR.PRECISE.summary: Rounds a number down to the nearest multiple, whatever its sign.

ISO.CEILING.summary: Rounds a number up to the nearest multiple, whatever its sign; the same as CEILING.PRECISE.

ROMAN.summary: Converts a number to Roman numerals, as text.

SEC.summary: The secant of an angle in radians.

SECH.summary: The hyperbolic secant of a number.

SIN.summary: The sine of an angle in radians.

SINH.summary: The hyperbolic sine of a number.

TAN.summary: The tangent of an angle in radians.

TANH.summary: The hyperbolic tangent of a number.

AVERAGEA.summary: The mean of its arguments, counting text as 0 and TRUE as 1.

MAXA.summary: The largest value, counting text as 0 and TRUE as 1.

MINA.summary: The smallest value, counting text as 0 and TRUE as 1.

STDEVA.summary: The sample standard deviation, counting text as 0 and TRUE as 1.

STDEVPA.summary: The population standard deviation, counting text as 0 and TRUE as 1.

VARA.summary: The sample variance, counting text as 0 and TRUE as 1.

VARPA.summary: The population variance, counting text as 0 and TRUE as 1.

CHISQ.TEST.summary: The probability from a chi-squared test of independence.

F.TEST.summary: The two-tailed probability that two samples' variances are not significantly different.

T.TEST.summary: The probability from a Student's t-test.

Z.TEST.summary: The one-tailed probability of a z-test.

GAMMALN.PRECISE.summary: The natural logarithm of the gamma function.

BINOM.INV.summary: The smallest number of successes whose cumulative binomial probability reaches a criterion.

BINOM.DIST.RANGE.summary: The binomial probability of a number of successes, or of a range of them.

ERROR.TYPE.summary: A number for the kind of an error value.

ISEVEN.summary: TRUE when a number is even.

ISNONTEXT.summary: TRUE when a value is not text.

ISODD.summary: TRUE when a number is odd.

ISREF.summary: TRUE when a value is a reference.

SHEET.summary: The sheet number of a reference or sheet name.

SHEETS.summary: The number of sheets in a reference, or in the workbook.

LENB.summary: The number of bytes in a text, counting double-byte characters as two.

LEFTB.summary: The first bytes of a text.

RIGHTB.summary: The last bytes of a text.

MIDB.summary: Bytes from the middle of a text, from a start position.

REPLACEB.summary: Replaces bytes at a position in a text.

FINDB.summary: The byte position of one text in another, case-sensitive.

SEARCHB.summary: The byte position of one text in another, ignoring case.

BAHTTEXT.summary: A number as Thai text with "Baht".

LOOKUP.summary: Finds a value in one row or column and returns the item at the same position in another.

TRIMRANGE.summary: A range without its empty outer rows and columns.

GETPIVOTDATA.summary: A value from a pivot table, by field and item names.
